task_name: World 137 Task B  -  ASC 606 Principal-vs-Agent Gross-to-Net Adjustments, Gross Margin % Bridge, Balance Sheet Tie-Out & Close Hold
prompt: Continuing your October 2026 close audit of Beacon Retail Media & Fulfillment LLC in beacon_retail_media_oct2026_obe_cpa_tb_and_principal_agent.xlsx, evaluate the three October 2026 revenue streams in Client_Contracts_Oct2026 (Velvet Home ad-spend management pass-through, Harbor Grocers custom kitted retail displays, and third-party brand drop-ship marketplace orders) under ASC 606-10-55-36 through 55-40 Principal vs. Agent indicators. Provide the ASC 606 gross-to-net adjusting journal entries, reconcile unadjusted to audited October 2026 GAAP Net Revenue, COGS, Gross Margin %, Operating Expenses (including any reclassified marketing expense from Task A), and Net Income, and prove the October 31, 2026 Balance Sheet tie-out and close-readiness status.

rubric.description: Evaluates STREAM-1 (Velvet Home ad-spend management) as Agent under ASC 606-10-55-36..40 (client owns ad accounts, zero inventory risk, zero pricing discretion), netting $100,000.00 pass-through media spend via Dr 4100 Agency Media Revenue $100,000.00 / Cr 5100 Media Pass-Through Cost COGS $100,000.00 to report $15,000.00 GAAP Net Agency Fee Revenue ($0.00 5100 COGS).

Evaluates STREAM-2 (Harbor Grocers custom POP displays) as Principal under ASC 606-10-55-36..40 (Beacon contracts factory production in its own name, warehouses inventory, bears transit/damage risk, and sets standalone price), retaining gross $68,000.00 Revenue in 4110 and $41,500.00 COGS in 5110.

Evaluates STREAM-3 (third-party brand drop-ship marketplace) as Agent under ASC 606-10-55-36..40 (brands set retail prices, ship directly from brand warehouses, and bear return/inventory risk), netting $70,400.00 brand remittances via Dr 4120 Drop-Ship Marketplace Revenue $70,400.00 / Cr 5120 Drop-Ship Brand Remittance COGS $70,400.00 to report $9,600.00 GAAP Net Commission Revenue ($0.00 5120 COGS).

Reconciles total October 2026 Revenue from $263,000.00 unadjusted gross ($115,000.00 + $68,000.00 + $80,000.00) to $92,600.00 GAAP Net Revenue (-$170,400.00 agent netting = $15,000.00 + $68,000.00 + $9,600.00).

Reconciles total October 2026 COGS from $211,900.00 unadjusted ($100,000.00 + $41,500.00 + $70,400.00) to $41,500.00 GAAP COGS (-$170,400.00 agent netting), conserving $51,100.00 Gross Profit while correcting Gross Margin % from 19.43% distorted to 55.18% ($51,100.00 / $92,600.00).

Reconciles October 2026 Operating Expenses from $28,400.00 unadjusted (6110) to $32,600.00 audited (+$4,200.00 Check #1842 in 6150 Marketing & Trade Shows), reconciling Net Income from $22,700.00 unadjusted to $18,500.00 audited (-$4,200.00 change).

Proves the post-close October 31, 2026 Balance Sheet tie-out: Total Assets $260,400.00 ($112,400.00 1010 + $25,000.00 1020 + $123,000.00 1100) equals Total Liabilities $77,300.00 (2000 AP) plus Total Members' Equity $183,100.00 ($130,000.00 3200 Retained Earnings + $34,600.00 3900 Opening Balance Equity + $18,500.00 audited Net Income).

Reports October 2026 close status as held under pending_cpa_trial_balance until Keller & Associates CPAs delivers the signed 2025 Form 1065 and final adjusted trial balance to clear the $34,600.00 cutover 3900 balance.
